title: Gentle Calm
steps: Sit comfortably and let your shoulders relax.
Breathe in gently through your nose for 4 seconds.
closing: Let your breathing return to its normal rhythm when you are ready.

title: Slow Exhale
steps: Place both feet on the floor if that feels comfortable.
Repeat 5 times without forcing your breath.
closing: Notice whether your shoulders or jaw feel a little less tense.
